description: Probes at d0c490721: send(self(), :hello); receive do :other -> :x after 10 -> dbg(:timeout) end; dbg(:end) prints neither :timeout nor :end and exits 0 on run and interp, with or without a message sent. Build prints :timeout then :end, as Elixir does. The process never resumes after the timer: a silent halt in the exec runtime's timer/wake path, with no panic. Not related to fz-sc8.60's schema registration (the interpreter registers those schemas and still fails). Find the cause.
title: A process resumes after its receive's after timer fires, on the JIT and the interpreter
